name: Question 7
problem:
Prove that ${n}^{2}+2n-3$ is odd if $n$ is even.

Since $n$ is even, it can be expressed as $n=\,${{field-1}} for some integer $a.$

Now, writing ${n}^{2}+2n-3$ in terms of $a,$ we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}{n}^{2}+2n-3 & ={{field-2}}.\end{aligned}
$$

Let $b=$ {{field-3}}. Since $a$ is {{field-4}}, we have that $b$ is {{field-5}}.

Therefore, we have

$$
{n}^{2}+2n-3={{field-6}},
$$
